name: Tags: the cost of donating and the tie rule
description: Table 2 of Riolo, Cohen & Axelrod 2001 and Table 8 of Edmonds & Hales 2003: the donation rate over 30 000 generations against the cost of donating (benefit 1, 3 pairings), under each tie rule. Measured (release, seeds 1–5, recorded 2026-09-25), coin flip / current agent / opponent: costs 0.05–0.3: 73.4–73.7% under every rule; 0.4: 60.6–60.9%; 0.5: 45.8 / 27.1 / 46.8%; 0.6: 7.9 / 2.2 / 10.1%. The paper's 60.1, 24.7 and 2.2% match ties to the current agent.
